name: YTLPOWR
recent: YTL Power 近期因 Nvidia 相关市场动荡而股价承压，多篇报道指卖压可能与数据中心主题交易降温有关，同时券商认为跌势过度。公司也持续有凭单转换与 ESOS 行使产生的新股上市，并将在 12 月 3 日召开第 30 届常年股东大会。
notable: 公司发布第30届常年股东大会通知，将于2026年12月3日举行。
多篇报道指 YTL Power 因 Nvidia 相关市场动荡而面对卖压，券商 CGS International 与 NST 报道认为跌势过度。
公司持续因凭单转换及 ESOS 行使而发行新股并上市。
risks: EPF 在10月下旬至11月中旬期间多次申报其作为大股东权益的变动。
新闻标题显示 Nvidia 相关市场动荡与数据中心主题交易降温令 YTL Power 股价承压。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止期间，营收为63.25亿令吉，净利为4.235亿令吉，净利率6.7%；营收环比增长24.4%，净利环比增长30.0%；营收同比增长14.0%，但净利同比下降48.2%。

notable_en: The company issued notice for its 30th AGM to be held on 3 December 2026.
Several reports said YTL Power faced selling pressure amid Nvidia-related market turmoil, with CGS International and NST saying the decline is overdone.
The company continued to list new shares from warrant conversions and ESOS exercises.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple changes in its substantial shareholder interest from late October to mid-November.
News headlines indicate Nvidia-related market turmoil and cooling data centre thematic trades have pressured YTL Power's share price.
earnings_en: For the period ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM6.325 billion and net income was RM423.5 million, with a net margin of 6.7%; revenue rose 24.4% QoQ and net income rose 30.0% QoQ; revenue grew 14.0% YoY while net income fell 48.2% YoY.
